_note: The assumptions behind engines/costmodel.js and docs/research. Every number is an estimate unless its basis says it was read from the code. Change a number here and run `node tools/cost_model.js` to see every cost move. Prices are NOT here: they come from data/ai-engines.json.

tokens._basis: perSearchIn and perFetchIn are estimates of the page text a search or a full page read adds to the model's input. They are chosen so that the free preview (6 searches, 2 fetches, 1.3k prompt) comes to 30k input tokens, which is what data/ai-engines.json roleDefaults.research assumes. resendFactor 1 means each search call is billed once; if pause_turn continuations re-bill the whole conversation (no prompt caching is used) it is above 1: measure it.

scenario._basis: Counts of calls per report. leadRounds and leadsPerRound are the investigator's budget (DEFAULT_BUDGET: 4 rounds, 6 leads per round); low, typical and high are guesses about how many leads a real project opens until the meter has real data. reviewerLeads are the leads the reviewer adds, followed in one more round.

sweep_preview.label: Free sweep (the preview)
sweep_preview.where: engine/investigator.js sweep(); server.js previewBudget() 6 searches, 2 fetches, INVESTIGATE_PREVIEW_PANEL 1
sweep_preview.basis: prompt: measured, sweepPrompt for an Indian query with the playbook, chars/4. searches and fetches: the preview caps. out: estimate from the stored sample dossiers (15-43 facts); maxTokens 16000.

sweep_full.label: Full panel sweep (admin investigate, default depth)
sweep_full.where: engine/investigator.js DEFAULT_BUDGET searches 25, fetches 12, panel 0 = every engine; POST /api/admin/investigate
sweep_full.basis: caps read from the code; usage below the caps is an estimate; maxTokens 16000.

lead_following.label: Lead following (rounds)
lead_following.where: engine/investigator.js followRound(); budget leadSearches 10, leadFetches 6, leadPanel 2, leadsPerRound 6, rounds 4
lead_following.basis: prompt: measured, leadPrompt with a 6,000-character context (digest(d, 6000)). searches and fetches: the caps; out: estimate, maxTokens 16000.

reviewer.label: Reviewer (the critic)
reviewer.basis: prompt: 147 tokens of template plus the digest (measured on the stored samples: 903, 1092 and 2748 tokens; the cap is 14,000 characters = 3,500 tokens). out: estimate.

question_writer.label: Question writer
question_writer.basis: prompt: 160 tokens of template plus the digest. out: the stored samples hold 16, 20 and 30 questions of 2.8k, 3.5k and 5.7k tokens; estimate.

pdf.label: PDF
pdf.where: engine/pdf.js: headless Chromium on the server, no provider call
pdf.basis: no provider cost; the server's CPU and memory only (PDF_CONCURRENCY 2)

legacy_pass.label: Legacy brief: three focused passes (record, track, voice)
legacy_pass.where: engine/searchLane.js runPass(); one engine.run() per facet, SEARCH_USES_PER_PASS 8, maxTokens 4000
legacy_pass.basis: prompt: measured. searches: cap 8. out: estimate from the 10-finding limit; maxTokens 4000. Three calls per brief.

legacy_adviser.label: Legacy brief: adviser
legacy_adviser.basis: prompt: about 330 tokens of template plus the findings as JSON (up to 30 findings). out: at most 4 readings and 6 questions; estimate.

translate_batch.label: Translation (legacy brief only), one batch of 30 strings
translate_batch.where: engine/translate.js translateBatch(); maxTokens 8000; cached per string and language
translate_batch.basis: prompt: about 650 tokens of rules and glossary plus 30 strings of about 35 tokens. out: similar for Latin scripts, up to 2.5 times for Indic, Arabic and Chinese scripts (high). The investigator's dossier is not translated: collectTexts reads the legacy brief fields only.

translate_check.label: Translation meaning check (sensitive strings), one call
translate_check.basis: about 120 tokens of template plus an english and a translation per sensitive string; estimate.

document_check.label: Document check (the buyer's own upload)
document_check.where: engine/documents.js extractFields(); maxTokens 800; personal data, so only AI_PERSONAL_DATA_ENGINES
document_check.basis: data/ai-engines.json roleDefaults.documents assumes 4000 in; a scanned PDF page is roughly 1.5k to 3k tokens; estimate.

premium_wave.label: Premium search: one engine's pass over the expanded names
premium_wave.where: search/premium/index.js; one runEach per wave, an engine per call
premium_wave.basis: prompt: the sweep prompt plus the list of names to search under. searches and fetches: the policy's depth settings.

premium_verify.label: Premium search: second pass on one weak or conflicting finding
premium_verify.basis: a short targeted prompt: the claim, what disagrees, and the instruction to find an official or independent second source.

netPrice._basis: Buyer prices come from data/price-book.json (ladders by currency and the fx table), net of GST where ShelterKart collects it (India, 18% inclusive in data/tax-profiles.json). The rungs below are the ones nearest to the INR 3,000-style prices.
